name: Demesne Arbalists
headerMeta: Silver era · Ranged Infantry · Crossbow · 160 leadership · Tier 3 / Mastery
pitch: High per-shot crossbow damage that demands close positioning — huge drop-off means you need to be near the fight to matter, even though press-2 stretches its reach further. The 2026-06-25 Piercing Bolts nerf (target count 2→1, fire rate −16%) strips its multi-target value and may force a line-clearing-to-single-target shift.

doctrines.effect: Alt for Epic Crossbow V -- older Double Fire variant, fires 2 bolts for 8s, 45s CD. Filler.
doctrines.note: unlocks Double Fire (unit-unique, can't combine with Focus Fire, 45s CD), +12% rate of fire, +1 shot to spell (6→7 arrows) — OP flags name unconfirmed

doctrines.effect: Huge per Amya: +1 additional target penetration on top of baseline Penetrating Shots. Mandatory per Amya. OP note: "confirm exact name."

veterancy.label: Top Line
veterancy.body: Do NOT take the last node.

battleRole.positioning: Huge damage drop-off — stay within brawl range to land impact; press 2 stretches reach further than the rest of the kit. {1}
battleRole.tips: Never overlap Double Fire with Double Shot; fire them sequentially, one then the other. {1} Either Double Fire + rate-of-fire doctrine or basic rate-of-fire adds +1 shot to the spell (6→7 arrows); Bolt Penetration is equally mandatory. Accuracy and Ammo aren't strict requirements — swap for Hero DMG (pen) or any piercing DMG increase. {1}
